seasonRead.headline: 2019–20: Transition and inside offense split the top
paragraphs: The 2019–20 model learned 6 forward styles. Rush / Transition Chance Creator led with 179 of 459 forwards (39.0%), followed by Interior Net-Front Finisher at 27.5%.

Rush / Transition Chance Creator leads, but Interior Net-Front Finisher and the third profile keep the map from becoming a runaway. Those three styles account for 90.8%, leaving 9.2% across the final three identities.

seasonRead.headline: 2019–20: Two profiles nearly absorb the defense pool
paragraphs: The 2019–20 model learned 4 defense styles. Play-Driving Puck-Moving Defenseman led with 112 of 240 defenders (46.7%), followed by Shot-Blocking Defensive Defenseman at 40.4%.

Play-Driving Puck-Moving Defenseman and Shot-Blocking Defensive Defenseman combine for 87.1% of defenders. With the top three at 99.6% across four learned styles, the fourth profile is statistically peripheral.
